paragraphs.text: Seal is a creature type used for cards that depict a species of fin-footed, semi-aquatic, marine mammals.
Seals have solely appeared in mono- blue .
The type first appeared on Howler's Heavy in Aetherdrift .
The type returned in the Universes Beyond set Avatar: The Last Airbender for the cards Tiger-Seal and Turtle-Seals .
Seals are known to exist on the shores of Dominaria , alonsgide their walrus relatives.
On Lorwyn-Shadowmoor seals are only rarely seen on the Shadowmoor half. They inhabit the rivers as there are no seas. They are associated with selkies .
